ledger.x: c. 1084: Zvenyhorod is founded as the appanage of Volodar Rostyslavych. 'Around the year of 1084' Zvenyhorod, Terebovlia and Peremyshl were founded within the Principality of Volhynia; 'Zvenyhorod went to Volodar Rostyslavych, others to his brothers'. The page says 'around'; the year is its own, the land my reading.
1141: Zvenyhorod merges into the Principality of Halych.

certainty.note: No boundary on the page; a radius round the capital.
